statement: Search the repository/Arsenal and current literature-facing assets for a materially distinct exact global cut or reusable theorem/adapter that can reduce the FULL178 numerical census without replaying EX5 Cycle1 or the active EX5 BTVA route.

scope.required_output: reuse ledger plus one or more LIVE/UNTESTED distinct route candidates or an audited no-new-actionable-route diagnosis within searched assets

matches.reason: It would reduce the integral Picard64 completion equations themselves modulo finite rings; current assets do not yet source-lock the indexed-terminal -> complete Picard64 system, and constructing that bridge here would duplicate active EX5 BC2-02.

attempts.summary: For an exact FULL178 indexed-terminal t, reduce its source-locked integral Picard64 completion system modulo one or more finite rings; if the local completion set is empty, reject t or an exact terminal stratum monotonically.
attempts.blocker: The current terminal index determines 11 pairing-prefix coordinates but the complete Picard64 target/equations are not yet source-locked. PR#1742 BC2-02 explicitly names indexed terminal -> integral Picard64 completion as the next exact unit.
attempts.reopen_condition: A retained/audited exact indexed-terminal -> integral Picard64 completion system (or eliminated equivalent) becomes available through the EX5 external-consumption gate; then test local emptiness on one bounded exact terminal/stratum before any scale-out.
attempts.exact_population: The 688101306360803751427719294-member indexed terminal family over the frozen 178 residual unibranch rows, addressed by (row_id,d,e,terminal_rank); any cut must preserve this exact manifest.
hypotheses: complete integral Picard64 completion constraints are source-locked for the addressed terminal/stratum
all finite-ring reductions are necessary consequences of those exact constraints
the preimage from a rejected residue/stratum back to terminal ranks is exact and population-preserving
attempts.distinctness: Unlike S34-W02, this route has no Mordell-Weil parameter or quotient rational-point claim; unlike EX5R-MOD it acts directly on Picard64 completion feasibility rather than a new modular/uniformization object.

attempts.summary: Encode one complete terminal stratum's exact Picard64 completion constraints as an exact rational/integer system and emit a replayable dual/Farkas or proof-producing MIP certificate proving the whole stratum infeasible.
attempts.blocker: No source-locked complete indexed-terminal -> Picard64 constraint system exists yet on this branch; assembling it would duplicate the active EX5 BC2-02 target-to-completion adapter.
attempts.reopen_condition: After a retained/audited exact completion system is consumed, try exact LP dual infeasibility first; if the LP relaxation is feasible, use a proof-producing exact integer certificate only on a bounded representative stratum.
attempts.exact_population: A complete explicitly keyed subset of the same frozen FULL178 indexed terminal family; certificate scope must be encoded in the artifact and cannot be extrapolated across rows/strata.
hypotheses: all completion constraints and bounds used in the certificate are exact consequences of FULL178 semantics
certificate arithmetic is exact and independently replayable
integer-specific cuts, if used, are themselves proof-producing and valid for every terminal in the certified stratum

attempts.summary: Merge residual completion states by an exact finite-state/BDD-style equivalence and enumerate only quotient states.
attempts.blocker: No new source-valid monotone rejection predicate was identified; state merging alone does not remove an exact receiver subset.
attempts.reopen_condition: Only re-enter if a new population-preserving monotone pruning/reduction predicate is proved that is not already supplied by S32-PW01.
attempts.exact_reduction: Falls under EX5R-ENUM-001's duplicate key NUM178|EXACT_BRANCH_BOUND|COMPLETE_PARTITION and the existing S32-PW01 exact enumeration/compression/indexer unless a new pruning theorem is added.

attempts.summary: Attempt to import S34-W02 global Mordell-Weil congruence exclusion as a FULL178 cut.
attempts.blocker: FULL178 terminal prefixes are not presented as a certified complete Mordell-Weil group with all torsion translates, and no exact quotient-to-terminal receiver functions are available. The required object/population hypotheses therefore fail.
attempts.reopen_condition: A future exact adapter identifies a nonempty FULL178 terminal subset with a certified complete MW-lattice receiver and exact quotient-to-parent functions satisfying every S34-W02 hypothesis.

exact_findings: The current FULL178 terminal object is an exact 11-pairing prefix inside (row_id,d,e), not a complete Picard64 target.
The active EX5 BC2-02 preflight localizes the missing source-controlled bridge to indexed terminal -> integral Picard64 completion (or exact eliminated equivalent) -> Reynolds z.

Any sound modular-local or dual-infeasibility global cut found in this lane needs that exact completion system first; building it here would violate the N105 anti-duplication rule against active EX5 work.
Pure compression/state quotienting without a new pruning predicate is already covered by S32-PW01 / EX5R-ENUM.
S34-W02 is a real formal global congruence weapon but its Mordell-Weil object hypotheses do not match the current FULL178 terminal receiver.
